# windows_smb_share (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of an existing SMB share on a remote Windows host without managing it.

Declarative attributes of the sibling resource (except the lookup key `name`) are intentionally absent as inputs: the observed values are exposed read-only instead, including the full share access lists and the `special` flag that marks administrative shares (`ADMIN$`, `C$`, `IPC$`).

Returns an error when the share does not exist on the target host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Look up the observed state of an existing SMB share.
data "windows_smb_share" "finance" {
  name = "Finance"
}

output "finance_path" {
  value = data.windows_smb_share.finance.path
}

output "finance_read_access" {
  value = data.windows_smb_share.finance.read_access
}

output "finance_special" {
  value = data.windows_smb_share.finance.special
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SMB share name on the target host. The share must already exist.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `caching_mode` (String) Offline file caching mode, as observed on the host: None, Manual, Programs, Documents or BranchCache.
- `change_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted change share access, as observed on the host.
- `concurrent_user_limit` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent users (0 means no limit), as observed on the host.
- `description` (String) Share description, as observed on the host.
- `encrypt_data` (Boolean) Whether SMB encryption is required for the share, as observed on the host.
- `folder_enumeration_mode` (String) Folder enumeration mode, as observed on the host: Unrestricted or AccessBased.
- `full_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted full share access, as observed on the host.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: the SMB share name.
- `no_access` (Set of String) Trustees explicitly denied share access, as observed on the host.
- `path` (String) Local absolute path of the shared directory, as observed on the host.
- `read_access` (Set of String) Trustees granted read share access, as observed on the host.
- `special` (Boolean) Whether the share is administrative (owned by Windows).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
